% tocloft's \newlistof without hyperref. older.exp is the list that an
% older LaTeX wrote for this document, with a three-argument \contentsline,
% which tex4ht's four-argument \contentsline reads past the end of the
% file.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tocloft}
\newlistof{example}{exp}{Examples}
\newcommand{\example}[1]{\refstepcounter{example}\par\noindent Example~\theexample: #1%
  \addcontentsline{exp}{example}{\protect\numberline{\theexample}#1}\par}
\begin{document}
\listofexample
\section{First}
Text of the first section.
\example{A new example}
\end{document}
